cover.lede: Nine ways to put your brand in front of veterans and Bitcoiners at the third annual Bitcoin Veterans Summit at Bitcoin Park, Nashville. **Two tiers are already gone.**

paragraphs: In 2024, Bitcoin Veterans came together for the first time IRL during the Bitcoin Conference in Nashville. What followed can only be described as a **groundswell of interest and participation**. We have worked to spread the word of Bitcoin and Freedom Tech to our fellow Veterans, and sought to enrich our communities through lessons learned and knowledge gained.

On November 9th and 10th we return to Nashville to hone our skills, expand our knowledge, share our expertise, and discuss the next steps in our journey. We would be honored and grateful if you would consider sponsoring our mission.
audience: Veterans seeking purpose, autonomy, and community
You do not need to be a veteran to participate
